records.reason: Free action that triggers a Recall Knowledge check at the table; grants no standing statistic.
Free-action movement of you and your mortar, resolved at the table; no sheet statistic changes.
An action that reveals a target creature's IWR without a check — information about a TARGET, GM-supplied.
A 1-minute exploration/investigation activity whose result the GM narrates; the app does not model it.
Spellshape action that recovers a spell disrupted this round; a table-resolved re-cast, not a slot or spell grant.
Lets you pick an untriggered snare back up and redeploy it — snare handling resolved at the table; no sheet statistic.
Duplicate record of the same snare-redeployment permission; nothing mechanical lands on the sheet.
Ikon imbue whose entire effect is a mark on an ENEMY that taxes the healing it later receives; only the target's statistics change.
Scrying aimed at you must counteract against a DC you already have; the redirection to your progenitor is GM-adjudicated and grants no bonus to record.
Reaction that makes a foe reroll its spell attack against a new target; affects the enemy's roll only.
Reaction that replaces an ALLY's attack roll; it changes only the ally's result.
An action combining a Strike with an Athletics check to pull the target; entirely table-resolved and target-facing.

You move 5 feet farther whenever you Sneak (up to your Speed) — a real, repeatable movement bonus the sheet never shows. The 'stay undetected in dim light' clause is a table ruling and is left in the when-text only.

situational.when: when you Sneak, up to your Speed

records.reason: A blood magic effect that makes you roll a spell attack to hurt the spellcaster who damaged you; the whole effect lands on the attacker.
Rider on a successful Counterspell that turns the countered spell back on its caster; only the caster is affected.
Reaction that counteracts and reflects a spell using DCs and modifiers the sheet already computes; nothing new to store.
The dazzle lands on the enemy (correctly inert), but the printed Frequency of once every 10 minutes is a trackable per-period limit the sheet never shows.
Reaction to catch a falling or thrown item and optionally add it to your juggle; resolved at the table, no statistic changes.
Reaction that grants a melee Strike; an action resolved at the table.
Free action on initiative that uses an ability you already have (Channel Draconic Essence); adds no new statistic or resource.
An action that chains a lash Strike into a Grapple; the MAP wording only sequences the two attacks, it does not lower the penalty.
Grants an extra reaction usable only for Opportune Riposte — reaction economy is resolved at the table and the app does not track reactions per turn.
An action that deals acid damage and sickens a foe; all effects land on the target.

Your animal companion gains a specialization of your choice — that is exactly the COMPANION_MODS maturity-floor lane (as used by behold-a-pale-horse), and nothing currently applies it. The familiar branch (two extra familiar abilities) has no mod lane, so it is carried as a note rather than invented as a field.

companionMod.note: Reincarnated Companion: your animal companion is at least a specialized companion, gaining one specialization of your choice — pick it in Edit. If your fated companion is a familiar instead, it gains two additional familiar abilities (add them by hand). A slain fated companion is replaced at no cost during daily preparations.

records.reason: Gives temporary Hit Points to the ALLY your Lay on Hands healed; only the ally's statistics change.
Narrative: you reform days after being destroyed, at the GM's table; no sheet statistic.
A narrative resurrection anchor plus downtime; nothing mechanical applies while you are alive and playing.

Reaction that keeps you or an ally at 1 HP and heals them; the healing and wounded increase are applied at the table, and the once-per-day limit is expressed as the familiar going dormant rather than a feat Frequency.
A two-action deviant ability creating a concealing area; an action resolved at the table, and its Awakening riders affect creatures in the area.
Reaction that lets you Stride alongside fleeing prey and ignore non-magical difficult terrain during that move; movement resolved at the table, no standing Speed change.
An action that combines reloading with a ranged Strike; action compression resolved at the table.
The frightened reduction lands on another creature (correctly inert), but the printed Frequency of once every 10 minutes is a trackable limit the sheet never shows.
Stops a frightened ENEMY from dropping below frightened 1; only the target's condition is affected.
Permission to Strike a snare to set it off, resolved against the snare's Crafting DC at the table.
A psi-cantrip amp used at cast time; its effect (you become undetected by that one target) is applied at the table and replaces the cantrip's normal amp.
Applies a -2 circumstance penalty to the TARGET's AC; only the enemy's statistics change.
An action that deals extra damage to a foe you hit twice; damage lands on the target and scales at the table.
An action granting temporary Hit Points computed from level and Con; temp HP is entered through the HP control when used, not a standing statistic.

It retunes another ability's frequency (Barbed Quills, once per day, becomes once every 10 minutes) — exactly the usesUpgrade lane already used by stormy-heart/greater-despair, and nothing currently applies it. Note Barbed Quills lives in core.json's actions (granted by the quillcoat heritage), so the target record also needs the base limitedUses of {max:1,per:'day'} for the pip to appear.
Reaction that repeats an Athletics maneuver your student failed; an action resolved at the table.

Grants ACCESS to two uncommon items (the app does not gate item availability by access) and compresses Running Reload with a magazine — action sequencing at the table. No proficiency or familiarity is granted.
Reaction spending a Mythic Point for resistance to one triggering attack and one mythic-proficiency Strike; both are momentary and table-resolved.
Deals 5d6 spirit damage to the creature that damaged you; the entire effect lands on the attacker.
The healing is applied at the table (correctly inert), but 'once every 10 minutes' is a trackable per-period limit on the feat that the sheet never shows.
Healing from a 10-minute rest submerged in water — a rest/downtime effect applied through the HP control, not a standing statistic.
Temporary Hit Points gained when you damage a foe with your deity's favored weapon; temp HP is entered at the table when it happens.
A 10-minute re-preparation that regains an already-cast slot; it adds no slots to the sheet (spellSlotBonus would over-grant) and is resolved during play.
Lets you talk to and use Diplomacy with reptilian animals; the GM decides which animals count, and no proficiency or bonus is granted.
Reaction that lets you Shove an undead that critically failed against you; an action resolved at the table.
Duplicate record of the same reaction; nothing mechanical to store.
Lets you spend two prepared quick-deploy snares to deploy an unprepared one; snare bookkeeping resolved at the table.

Your eidolon gains resistance to physical damage equal to its Con modifier and nothing delivers it. The COMPANION_MODS eidolon iwr lane exists (elemental-eidolon, aon-celestial-mount) and takes display strings, including scaling ones.

iwr: resistance physical (equal to its Constitution modifier)
companionMod.note: Resilient Shell: your eidolon has resistance to physical damage equal to its Constitution modifier.

records.reason: Keeps a shield at 1 HP instead of being destroyed by a Shield Block; item durability is tracked at the table, and the once-per-shield limit is a GM/table note.
A two-action Strike that deafens the target; the whole effect is on the enemy.
Reaction that ends your composition to give ALLIES (and you, momentarily) sonic resistance against one instance of damage; a one-shot table-applied resistance, not a standing one.

It widens what your divine-font slots may hold: a font Heal can be spent to cast Cleanse Affliction, Clear Mind, Sound Body, or Sure Footing at the sacrificed spell's rank. build.ts models the font with a fixed `allowed` list (used for Battle Creed) that no record field can extend, so the player cannot record or cast these from the sheet.
A 10-minute exploration activity that draws a random harrow card for a new omen; the omen's suit is randomized at the table.
The restorative it produces is a table-resolved consumable (correctly inert), but 'at most once per 10 minutes' is a trackable per-period limit the sheet never shows.
Grants fast healing 5 to the creature you healed or revived; only that creature's statistics change.
Reaction that shatters held holy water or a vitality bomb on the attacker; damage lands on the enemy.
